live_agent_run.description: Live pinned Nemotron agent, extractor and synthesizer on the reviewed trastuzumab question with remote LangSmith trace; literature is the synthetic fixture.
synthesis_notes: 3 proposed statements failed grounding validation and were omitted; everything shown passed every check.
live_agent_run.answer: Tripling half-life gives higher endpoint occupancy than tenfold stronger affinity, but both remain above the 90% threshold at the 180-day horizon, so the simulation cannot show which maintains occupancy above threshold longer because duration is censored.
live_agent_run.structure_note: Coordinates of 1N8Z show where the binding partners touch in one experimental structure. They cannot determine occupancy over time, half-life, affinity or kinetic rates, so they give context and do not decide this question.
